L53-59 formatBytes(bytes): ported verbatim — 0 -> '0 B', k=1024, sizes B/KB/MB/GB/TB, log-based index, `fmtNumber(bytes/k^i, 1)` via the native fmtNumber shim.

L75 trailing newline preserved. No DOM elements, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components imported; only react, react-native StyleSheet, native AppText and theme tokens are used.
